stages.title: Stage 1: Getting Comfortable & Understanding the Market
stages.subtitle: Learn to look at the CPT and JHB nail markets with founder eyes, define our quality standard, and set up the core app workspace.

stages.title: Stage 2: Shaping the Product Rules Together
stages.subtitle: Turn market research into real decisions inside the app and set up our public brand identity.

stages.title: Stage 3: Dipping a Toe into Outreach (Low-Pressure DMs)
stages.subtitle: Start friendly, curiosity-based text chats with nail techs online while building the calendar, venue safety lock, and badge system.

stages.title: Stage 4: Building Real-World Voice & Salon Confidence
stages.subtitle: Graduate comfortably from text messages to short voice notes, warm 5-minute calls, and salon partner chats.

stages.title: Stage 5: Loading the App & Launching
stages.subtitle: Load verified CPT and JHB nail techs into the app, connect South African payments, test everything thoroughly, and welcome our first clients.

items.title: Defining Our Quality Standard & Workspace Setup

aqeelah.title: Set Up the Research Sheet & 'Certified Pro' Checklist
aqeelah.description: Create our Master Research Google Sheet (with tabs for Nail Techs and Independent Salons in CPT/JHB). Then write down the 5 to 7 non-negotiable checks that separate amazing nail work from bad work (cuticle neatness, apex structure, shaping, hygiene, retention).
aqeelah.deliverable: Google Sheet link + 5 to 7 Certified Pro quality rules
aqeelah.growthSkill: Trusting Your Judgement Instead of Overthinking
aqeelah.growthWhy: You already know a lot, but you let self-doubt and overthinking cloud your judgement. Think back to your shop when the techs you hired messed up and you literally had to go in and sort things out for clients yourself. Who better to write the checklist for what makes a nail tech genuinely good than someone who already lived through hiring the wrong people? You already know what quality you wished those techs had. Put those exact standards on paper and do not second-guess yourself.

tech.title: Initialise Flutter Multi-Platform Project & Backend
tech.description: Set up the Flutter workspace (iOS, Android, and Web Admin) and configure Firebase/Supabase authentication, database environments, and user role guards (client, tech, salon_partner, admin).
tech.deliverable: Base repository & auth role routing initialised

items.title: Learning How to Research (First 5 Nail Techs)

aqeelah.title: Find 5 Independent Nail Techs in CPT
aqeelah.description: Use the Instagram and TikTok search guide in the Research tab to find 5 independent nail techs in Cape Town whose work looks clean. Write down their handle, how they take bookings, and their price for a plain set.
aqeelah.deliverable: First 5 CPT nail techs logged in the sheet
aqeelah.growthWhy: In the past, whenever you did not know where to start, your first instinct was to panic and call your dad or ask someone else what to do. I want you to see that when you break something down into small pieces, you do not need to panic at all. Searching for 5 nail techs at a time and writing down their prices teaches you how to gather facts on your own. Once the facts are written down in front of you, your mind stops spiralling because the answer is right there on the sheet.

tech.title: Build Core Database Schemas & Security Rules
tech.description: Create database models for Users, Tech Profiles, Verified Commercial Venues, and Visual Contract Portfolio items (image URL, fixed base price, duration in minutes, allowed modifiers).

aqeelah.title: Find 5 More CPT Techs & Spot Booking Flaws
aqeelah.description: Add 5 more CPT nail techs to your sheet, and write down 1 annoying thing about trying to book each of them (such as no prices shown, 'WhatsApp only', or confusing policy highlights).
aqeelah.deliverable: 10 total CPT techs logged with booking pain points
aqeelah.growthSkill: Translating Past Frustrations Into Our Solution
aqeelah.growthWhy: When you look at other nail techs' pages, remember what frustrated you at your shop when techs were disorganised or didn't do things properly. Spotting those flaws on other pages shows you exactly why clients and good techs need the structure we are building.

tech.title: Build Auth Screens & Scout 5 JHB Nail Techs
tech.description: Implement login, registration, and role onboarding screens in Flutter, and add 5 independent nail techs in JHB to the shared research sheet.
tech.deliverable: Working auth screens + 5 JHB techs in sheet

items.title: The 'Mystery Shopper' Test & Visual Contract Card

aqeelah.title: Mystery Shop 2 Nail Techs on WhatsApp / IG
aqeelah.description: Message 2 nail techs as a normal customer asking how much a specific nail photo costs and when they have a slot next week. Time how long they take to reply and how many messages it takes to get a straight answer.
aqeelah.deliverable: Notes on how long the 2 mystery enquiries took
aqeelah.growthSkill: Seeing the Problem With Your Own Eyes
aqeelah.growthWhy: Because you hate calling people to make bookings yourself (and usually get your brother to do it), you already know how annoying booking beauty appointments is. Seeing how slow and awkward WhatsApp enquiries are proves why our 1-tap Visual Contract booking is so much better.

tech.title: Build the Signature Visual Contract Card UI
tech.description: Create the portfolio card component displaying the tech's real nail photo, hard-coded base price, exact appointment duration, tier badge, and verified venue tag.

items.title: The Google Maps 'Quiet Salon' Trick & Discovery Feed

aqeelah.title: Find 5 Independent Salons in CPT & Check Quiet Hours
aqeelah.description: Use Google Maps to find 5 independent salons in Cape Town. Scroll down to their 'Popular Times' bar graph for Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays to see which hours their chairs sit empty.
aqeelah.deliverable: 5 CPT salons with quiet mid-week hours logged
aqeelah.growthSkill: Using What You Lived Through at Your Shop
aqeelah.growthWhy: You know firsthand what it felt like having quiet days at your shop when chairs sat empty. When you look at Google Maps and see other salons sitting empty on a Tuesday afternoon, remember how that felt for you. You are not guessing what salon owners want because you have literally been in their shoes.

tech.title: Build the Visual Contract Discovery Feed & Scout 3 JHB Salons
tech.description: Build the scrollable discovery feed with CPT and JHB city filters, and add 3 independent salons in JHB (with quiet mid-week hours) to the shared sheet.
tech.deliverable: Scrollable discovery feed + 3 JHB salons logged

aqeelah.title: Decide Standard Add-On Modifiers & Time Additions
aqeelah.description: Look at your research sheet and decide on the standard optional switches a client can tap when booking a photo (such as Soak-Off / Removal, Extra Length, or Nail Repair) and how much extra time each one should add.
aqeelah.deliverable: Final list of add-on toggles and extra minutes
aqeelah.growthWhy: Usually you wait for someone else to lead, or you ask your dad, your brother, or me before settling on something because you start overthinking. You know how when you ask me, I ask you questions back so you realise you already knew the right answer? That is what this is. Make the call on the add-ons, lock it in, and do not doubt yourself afterwards.

tech.title: Build the Booking Screen & Dynamic Modifier Calculator
tech.description: Build the Visual Contract booking detail screen with live toggle switches that automatically recalculate the total price and appointment duration.
tech.deliverable: Dynamic price and duration booking screen

aqeelah.title: Set Up Official ABE Instagram & TikTok Pages
aqeelah.description: Choose our official handles, write a warm and clear 3-line bio explaining the Visual Contract concept, and plan our first 'Founding Techs' story highlight.
aqeelah.deliverable: Official IG & TikTok pages created with bio
aqeelah.growthSkill: Bringing Ideas Out of Your Head
aqeelah.growthWhy: You have so many good ideas in your mind, but sometimes they stay in your head because you overthink how to start. Setting up the page puts our brand into the real world so it is no longer just an idea in your head.

tech.title: Build the Tech Portfolio Upload Flow
tech.description: Create the screen for nail techs to upload a nail photo, set the fixed base price and duration, and select which optional add-ons apply.
tech.deliverable: Working portfolio upload flow for techs

aqeelah.title: Review the Clickable App Feed & Booking Prototype
aqeelah.description: Open the first clickable version of the app with Rio. Test scrolling through looks and toggling add-ons, and give honest feedback on anything that feels confusing for a beauty client or nail tech.
aqeelah.deliverable: List of UI/UX tweaks from your beauty perspective
aqeelah.growthSkill: Speaking Up as an Equal Partner
aqeelah.growthWhy: I built the code, but you know how nail clients and salon owners actually think. Tell me straight what works and what needs changing, and trust that your opinion matters here.

tech.title: Demo Stage 1 & 2 Prototype & Refine UI
tech.description: Walk Aqeelah through the clickable prototype and refine the layout, wording, and flow based on her feedback.

aqeelah.title: Make the Friendly DM Scripts Sound Like You
aqeelah.description: Read through the DM templates in the Scripts tab and tweak a few words so they sound natural, warm, and genuinely like how you speak.
aqeelah.deliverable: Personalised DM templates ready to copy-paste
aqeelah.growthWhy: When you have to message or speak to someone new, you normally freeze up because you do not know what to say. Having the script written out in your own words ahead of time means there is nothing left to overthink.

tech.title: Build the Tech Availability Calendar & Slot Engine
tech.description: Implement working hours, buffer times, and slot generation that accounts for the exact duration of the chosen Visual Contract plus selected modifiers.

items.title: First 5 Friendly DMs & Strict Venue-Only Lock

aqeelah.title: Send the 'Market Research Question' DM to 5 CPT Techs
aqeelah.description: Send Script 1 to just 5 nail techs from your sheet. You are not selling anything yet; you are complimenting their work and asking what annoys them most when clients book with them right now.
aqeelah.deliverable: 5 friendly research DMs sent in CPT
aqeelah.growthSkill: Taking the Intimidation Out of Reaching Out (Step 1)
aqeelah.growthWhy: I know how shy and intimidated you can feel reaching out to people. That is why we are not doing phone calls yet. It is just a friendly text message complimenting their nails and asking a simple question. Copy, paste, hit send, and do not overthink it.

tech.title: Enforce Strict Venue-Only Bookings & Message 5 JHB Techs
tech.description: Enforce the safety rule in code: every booking must link either to a Tech's Verified Commercial Studio or a Partner Salon Empty Chair (blocking house calls). Send the warm research DM to 5 JHB techs.
tech.deliverable: Venue-only safety lock + 5 JHB DMs sent

items.title: Replying to Techs & The Tier Badge System

aqeelah.title: Reply to Techs with Founding Invite & Message 5 More
aqeelah.description: Anyone who replied to Item 10 gets Script 2 (explaining how upfront payments and our 25% late-cancellation payout solve their exact frustration, and inviting them onto our Founding Tech list). Send Script 1 to 5 new CPT techs.
aqeelah.deliverable: Follow-up replies sent + 5 new CPT techs messaged
aqeelah.growthSkill: Realising People Want What We Have
aqeelah.growthWhy: Unlike the unreliable techs you dealt with in the past, good nail techs are desperate for a platform that pays them upfront and stops time-wasters. You are offering them something genuinely valuable.

tech.title: Build the Grading & Badge Engine UI
tech.description: Implement the logic and UI badges for Rising Tech, Verified Tech (auto-unlocked via bookings, rating threshold, and completion photos), and Certified Pro (unlocked via Aqeelah's audition approval).

aqeelah.title: Send a 30-Second Voice Note to 3 Interested Techs
aqeelah.description: Instead of typing, send a friendly 30-second voice note (Script 3) to 3 techs who showed interest, thanking them and asking for 5 photos of their favourite sets so we can build their preview page.
aqeelah.growthSkill: Warming Up Your Voice Before Calls (Step 2)
aqeelah.growthWhy: Because you hate phone calls, a 30-second voice note is the bridge between texting and calling. You can read Script 3 right off the screen, and if you mess up, you can delete and re-record it until you are happy.

tech.title: Build the Biometric + 4-Digit Randomised PIN Start Lock
tech.description: Generate a unique, randomised 4-digit PIN on the client's booking screen. Require the tech to pass Biometric/Selfie verification AND enter the client's 4-digit PIN to start the appointment timer.

items.title: Vetting Real Tech Photos & Live Completion Camera

aqeelah.title: Review & Approve Founding Tech Photos
aqeelah.description: Check the nail photos sent by interested techs against your Item 1 Quality Checklist. Confirm the exact price and duration for each approved look.
aqeelah.deliverable: Approved Founding Tech photo packs ready for upload
aqeelah.growthSkill: Protecting Our Brand From Bad Work
aqeelah.growthWhy: Remember how exhausting it was having to go into your shop to fix bad nail jobs for upset clients? By checking these photos properly now, you make sure only techs who actually know what they are doing get onto our app.

tech.title: Build the In-App Live Completion Camera Lock
tech.description: Force the 'Complete Appointment' button to open the native in-app camera directly (blocking gallery uploads) so the tech captures a live photo of the finished nails to unlock their payout.

items.title: Your First 5-Minute Warm Call & The Wallet Engine

aqeelah.title: Do a 5-Minute Warm Call with 2 Interested Techs
aqeelah.description: Use Script 4 to do a quick, friendly 5-minute call with 2 techs who already sent you their photos. Say hello, tell them their photos are approved, and briefly explain how weekly payouts and the 4-digit PIN work.
aqeelah.growthSkill: Remembering the Day You Called Your Uncle (Step 3)
aqeelah.growthWhy: I know you loathe phone calls and normally get your brother to make bookings for you. But whenever your mind tells you that you cannot make a call, remember the day your dad was rushed to hospital. You did not freeze up: you called your uncle out of nowhere and got the ambulance sorted yourself. If you could handle an emergency call like that, a 5-minute chat with a friendly nail tech who already sent you her photos is easy for you.

tech.title: Build the Closed-Loop Wallet & 75/25 Cancellation Split
tech.description: Implement the Client Closed-Loop Wallet (non-withdrawable credits), Tech Earnings Ledger (15% platform fee, weekly payouts, Instant Cash-Out), and Automated Cancellation Logic (75% client wallet / 25% tech on late client cancel).

items.title: Quiet Salon Outreach & Dispute Resolution View

aqeelah.title: Contact or Visit 3 Quiet Independent Salons in CPT
aqeelah.description: Use Script 5 and our 1-page 'Empty Chair' summary to contact or pop into 3 independent salons from your Item 5 list during their quiet mid-week hours. Show them how they can earn guaranteed fees from their spare nail stations.
aqeelah.deliverable: 3 CPT salons contacted with Empty Chair summary
aqeelah.growthSkill: Speaking Salon Owner to Salon Owner (Step 4)
aqeelah.growthWhy: Do not feel intimidated by salon owners. You literally owned a shop yourself, and you know what quiet days feel like. You are walking in with a 1-page sheet that helps them make money on their empty chairs.

tech.title: Build 3-Photo Dispute View, Empty Chair Portal & JHB Salons
tech.description: Create the side-by-side Admin Dispute tool (Portfolio Photo vs. Tech Camera Photo vs. Client Complaint Photo) and the Salon Partner station listing view. Contact 2 independent salons in JHB.
tech.deliverable: Dispute tool + Salon portal + 2 JHB salons contacted

items.title: Loading Founding Tech Profiles & SA Payments

aqeelah.title: Upload Founding Tech Portfolios & Send Previews
aqeelah.description: Load our approved CPT Founding Techs (their photos, fixed prices, durations, and add-ons) into the app and send each tech a screenshot of their live profile preview.
aqeelah.deliverable: First CPT Founding Tech profiles live in the app
aqeelah.growthSkill: Putting Pen to Paper & Seeing It Real
aqeelah.growthWhy: Usually ideas stay in your head because you do not know where to start. Seeing real nail techs loaded into our app because of the steps you ticked off proves what happens when you bring your ideas out of your head.

tech.title: Integrate SA Payment Gateways & Load JHB Profiles
tech.description: Connect Paystack or Peach Payments (Card tokenisation + Instant EFT) and PayJustNow (BNPL webhook) so full upfront funds land in our float account. Load JHB Founding Tech profiles.
tech.deliverable: Payment gateway sandbox & JHB profiles loaded

items.title: Full 'Break the App' Test Run & Security Audit

aqeelah.title: Test the Whole App as a Picky Client & Nail Tech
aqeelah.description: Use the test build on your phone from start to finish: book a nail look, toggle a soak-off, enter the 4-digit PIN, snap a live completion photo, and test a cancellation. Note anything that feels confusing.
aqeelah.deliverable: Sign-off on user experience & bug notes
aqeelah.growthSkill: Making Sure Clients Never Get Burned
aqeelah.growthWhy: Everything that went wrong with techs at your old shop is prevented here: upfront payment, the 4-digit PIN, and the live completion photo. Test it thoroughly so you feel 100% proud of how it works.

tech.title: Security Audit, Bug Fixes & Partner Salon Lock-In
tech.description: Audit database security rules (preventing wallet cash withdrawals or PIN spoofing), fix all issues found during Aqeelah's testing, and confirm partner salon stations in JHB and CPT.

items.title: Soft Launch with Founding Techs & First Clients

aqeelah.title: Post Launch Content & Welcome Our First CPT Clients
aqeelah.description: Share our first 'Inspo vs. Reality' posts featuring our Founding Techs' real work, confirm their calendars are active, and invite our first wave of CPT clients to book.
aqeelah.deliverable: Launch posts live & first CPT client bookings
aqeelah.growthWhy: Look back at Item 1 and look at where you are now. You did the research, trusted your judgement, sent the messages, made the calls, and brought this out of your head into reality.

tech.title: Deploy Production Builds & Monitor Live Transactions
tech.description: Deploy live iOS and Android builds, switch payment keys to production mode, and monitor webhooks, bookings, and payouts in real time.
tech.deliverable: Live production launch in CPT & JHB
